title: NotifyToast
description: Params of the notify.toast server-to-client notification: one transient in-window message the renderer presents with the kit's existing toast (frontend/src/ui/toast.tsx). It is the wire half of the toast SINK (ADR-0029, plan D2) — a toast is not a special case the pipeline routes around but a sink like any other, reached through a port the transport satisfies, so the router stays the only holder of 'where'. Title and body are untrusted presentation data written by whatever the user ran (ADR-0029 Section 2.3): they are rendered as text and never spliced into any other syntax. Level is stamped by nocx, never by the program — a program cannot forge danger — and its four values are the toast kit's own levels, so the renderer maps them without inventing a fifth.

title.description: The notification's title. Empty for an OSC 9 request, which carries one field: the renderer then presents the body alone rather than inventing a title the terminal did not send.

body.description: The notification's body. May be empty.

level.description: The severity nocx stamped, in the toast kit's own vocabulary.
